role: @MainActor service that owns per-session and bulk re-analysis (artifact detection, window selection, re-classification, re-scoring, archive write, baseline update, CloudKit re-upload), score-only rebuilds, the one re-score builder (rescoredBreakdown) and the static readiness / insufficient-data / ANS-balance helpers used by morning processing, acceptance, migrations and sample data.
types: ReanalysisService: class — re-analysis / re-score service built once by the composition root (AppDependencies.makeReanalysisService) with injected archive, HealthKit, pipeline, selector, detector, baseline tracker and provider/callback closures over the shared scoring context, archive signal and iCloud sync
state: closures settingsProvider, scoringConfigProvider, ansConfigProvider, trainingContextProvider, analyzeWithWindow, analyzeFullSession, onArchiveChanged, onSessionUploaded, onZonesStale (ReanalysisService.swift); analysisPipeline/ansConfigProvider are only used in ReanalysisService+Sleep.swift
mem:ReanalysisService.pendingSleepEdit — the last sleep-boundary edit started, which the next one waits for (set only by updateSessionSleepBoundaries)
toplevel: The class is @MainActor; every dependency is injected, the chart zones cache through the onZonesStale callback. A rescore is written through RescoreWrite (RescoreWrite.swift). Sleep retro-apply and manual window paths live in ReanalysisService+Sleep.swift extension. An extension at the end holds rescoreContext and the nonisolated re-score and classification (rescoredBreakdown(…context:), reclassifyHRVQuality(…baselineStats:)) that the instance methods and SleepBoundaryWrite share.
